messages:
sam: Heads-up — CI is flagging a SAST failure on the new serialization helper in feature/x. Looks like a false positive (tainted-sink on fmt.Sprintf used only in a test harness). Who owns the SAST evidence upload flow?
anita: @sam can you paste the CI log + PR link? we need the scanner evidence attached to the PR for the security review flow.
sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/8421
CI excerpt:
```
scanner: found potentially-unsafe-format at serialize.go:42
serialize.go:42: fmt.Sprintf("user=%s", userID) // test-only harness
```
This is only in a test fixture — not reachable in prod.
sec-bot: automation note — suggest adding label `security:needs-evidence` to trigger evidence pipeline :white_check_mark:.
cheng: Suggestion: attach the test harness path + a minimal repro and mark as `sast:false-positive` with a short rationale. Also, infra — does the job save the scanner JSON + build artifacts long enough for triage? need compiled test binary for forensics sometimes.
david: infra-team: retention is currently 30 days for nightly builds, PR builds are 7 days. @infra-team can we copy artifacts to the evidence bucket when label is applied?
infra-bot: queued copy job (job-id: cp-9876) to s3://redwood-security-evidence/8421 on label add. ETA ~30s.
anita: another angle — KMS access. The evidence bucket is encrypted with a CMK. The PR pipeline runs under service-account:ci-runner which lacks kms:Decrypt on that key, so automated attach can fail. @infra-team can we grant kms:Decrypt to ci-runner scoped to the attach-evidence action?
infra-team: we can add a conditional IAM binding for the pipeline role when action=attach-evidence; requires a small policy change + audit log config. we'll open a change request and link it here.
sam: proposed runbook for review gate automation:
1) contributor adds `security:needs-evidence` label
2) automation copies artifacts + scanner JSON to evidence bucket via job cp-xxxx
3) sec-bot posts attachment (scanner JSON + build metadata) to PR and adds event id header
4) security engineer triages within 24h and sets `security:triaged` + owner
5) if FP, owner annotates suppression with justification and schedules nightly re-run to confirm no regressions
Any objections?
cheng: one request — record an audit log entry when RBAC grants are changed and when sec-bot attaches evidence. We need an immutable trace to map RBAC changes -> PR actions for incident investigations.
anita: agreed. We'll include an X-Evidence-Event header with a correlation id (e.g., X-Evidence-Event: ev-8421-1729012345) in the attachment metadata and emit a CloudAuditLog entry on role grants.
sam: great. I'll draft the PR template and update the security runbook doc. tagging #oncall for visibility :eyes:
infra-team: CR created: CR-2026-78 (policy change + audit sink). Assigning to @david for IAM review.
david: ack. I'll review the IAM change and confirm KMS conditional policy won't widen permissions.
sam: thanks everyone — will follow up with the runbook PR and the evidence template.
